answer.sourceLine: Stephen King's Rita Hayworth and Shawshank Redemption contains the line, as transcribed by Wikiquote. The novella appeared in Different Seasons in 1982, before the familiar film adaptation.

trail: Wikiquote's novella section ↗ records the phrase as part of King's prose.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: The line already belonged to the Shawshank novella before it became familiar as screen dialogue. King's collection page ↗ places the story among four pieces published together in August 1982, which prevents crediting the later film as the original work.
